# Test the parsing logic step by step
original_url = ''postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:postgrespassword@postgresql:5432/todo_chatbot?sslmode=disable''
print\(''Original URL:'', original_url\)

# Step 1: Split on ''?''
if ''?'' in original_url:
    base_url = original_url.split\(''?''\)[0]
    query_part = original_url.split\(''?''\)[1]
    print\(''Base URL:'', base_url\)
    print\(''Query part:'', query_part\)
    
    # Step 2: Split query on ''&''
    params = []
    for param in query_part.split\(''&''\):
        print\(''Processing param:'', param\)
        if ''='' in param:
            key, value = param.split\(''='', 1\)
            print\(f''  Key: {key}, Value: {value}''\)
            # Check if key should be excluded
            excluded_keys = [''sslmode'', ''sslcert'', ''sslkey'', ''sslrootcert'', ''sslfactory'', ''sslcompression'']
            if key.lower\(\) not in excluded_keys:
                print\(f''  Keeping param: {param}''\)
                params.append\(f''{key}={value}''\)
            else:
                print\(f''  Excluding param: {param} \(key {key} is in exclusion list\)''\)
        else:
            print\(f''  Adding param without =: {param}''\)
            params.append\(param\)
    
    print\(''Params list after processing:'', params\)
    
    # Step 3: Reconstruct URL
    if params:
        clean_url = f''{base_url}?{""&"".join\(params\)}''
    else:
        clean_url = base_url
        
    print\(''Final clean URL:'', clean_url\)
else:
    print\(''No query part in URL''\)
    clean_url = original_url
")
